clean_source_blocks.text: Witnesses describe 'horrible' and 'chaotic' scene after Seattle Center shooting Three people have been killed and several others injured following a shooting at a food festival near the Space Needle in Seattle on Sunday. Police said there were two suspects who were shooting at each other. One of the suspects is in custody and the other still at large, although officials have said there is no threat to public. Shots rang out at around 18:00 local time (01:00 GMT) at one of the city's most popular tourist spots and as the annual Bite of Seattle food festival drew even more people to the downtown area. Two deaths were confirmed at the scene, and one person died later in hospital. Those injured include a two-year-old boy, officials said. Videos shared online showed people taking shelter inside the city's iconic Space Needle.

A shooting broke out Sunday evening at the Seattle Center, on the sidelines of the annual food festival Bite of Seattle near the Space Needle, leaving at least two dead and five injured, according to law enforcement. Emergency services responded shortly after 6 PM following several reports of gunshots. Medical teams attempted to resuscitate two victims, but they were declared dead at the scene by Seattle firefighters. The third victim was taken to Harborview Medical Center but died from their injuries. Four other people were injured and are receiving care. The shooting occurred while thousands of visitors were attending this popular event, which every year brings together dozens of food stalls and outdoor concerts at the Seattle Center. One person was arrested and taken into custody, but police have launched a manhunt for a second suspect who fled the scene.

A tragic shooting incident at the annual Bite of Seattle Festival has left two dead and multiple injured, including a young child, highlighting the ongoing issue of gun violence in the US. Two people were killed and several others were injured -- including a child -- in a shooting incident reported at the Seattle food festival on July 26, Sunday evening in the USA, CNN reported, citing fire department officials. CNN reported that the shooting took place just a block from the city's iconic Space Needle. The Seattle Fire Department said that it responded to reports of a shooting at the Seattle Center just after 6 pm (local time). As per a report by AP, as many as five patients were admitted to the Harborview Medical Centre. A 56-year-old woman was in serious condition while being transported to the hospital.

She had originally announced two suspects had been taken into custody before updating her statement later on Sunday evening. Four of the injured were taken to hospital in a stable condition, while a fifth chose not to, the fire department said. One attendee told local media that scene was "pure chaos" following the gunfire Representatives for Seattle and Washington state have condemned the shooting as an act of "senseless violence". "My prayers are with the families of the victims, and the responders as they work to keep people safe," Washington Governor Bob Ferguson said on social media. The US flag on top of the Space Needle was lowered to half-mast after the shooting Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal, who represents Seattle, added: "Our hearts go out to all those impacted by this senseless violence," she wrote on social media.

Three people have been killed and several others injured following a shooting at a food festival near the Space Needle in Seattle on Sunday.

Police said there were two suspects who were shooting at each other. One of the suspects is in custody and the other still at large, although officials have said there is no threat to public.

Shots rang out at around 18:00 local time (01:00 GMT) at one of the city's most popular tourist spots and as the annual Bite of Seattle food festival drew even more people to the downtown area.

Two deaths were confirmed at the scene, and one person died later in hospital. Those injured include a two-year-old boy, officials said.

Videos shared online showed people taking shelter inside the city's iconic Space Needle.

People could be seen crouched on the ground, taking cover behind pillars and shelves of merchandise in the Space Needle's lobby during the shooting.

Faith Adia Hunter told Associated Press that one of the shooters was near her and her friends when they heard the shots, sending them fleeing for shelter in the Seattle Children's Museum.

"We were right next to him when it started so we took off running," she said. "So we took off running too into the building with the crowd."

The Seattle Police Department said an investigation remains ongoing and urged the public to avoid the area.

Mayor Katie Wilson said in a statement that she wanted to "thank the Seattle police officers who responded to the scene and took a suspect into custody".

She had originally announced two suspects had been taken into custody before updating her statement later on Sunday evening.

Four of the injured were taken to hospital in a stable condition, while a fifth chose not to, the fire department said.

payload.title: Kolme kuoli ampumisessa Seattlen ruokafestivaalilla – toinen epäilty kateissa
payload.summary: Seattle Centerissä tapahtuneessa ampumisessa kuoli kolme ihmistä ja useita loukkaantui. Poliisin mukaan kaksi epäiltyä ampui toisiaan kohti.
payload.content:
Kolme ihmistä kuoli ja useita loukkaantui sunnuntai-iltana 26. heinäkuuta ampumisessa Seattle Centerissä Yhdysvalloissa. Väkivalta puhkesi vuosittaisen Bite of Seattle -ruokafestivaalin aikana lähellä kaupungin tunnettua Space Needle -näköalatornia, kun alueella oli tuhansia kävijöitä. Poliisin mukaan kaksi epäiltyä ampui toisiaan kohti. Toinen heistä on otettu kiinni, mutta toinen pakeni tapahtumapaikalta ja on yhä kateissa.

## Kaksi uhria kuoli tapahtumapaikalla

Laukauksista ilmoitettiin hieman kello 18:n jälkeen paikallista aikaa eli noin kello 1.00 GMT. Poliisi, palokunta ja ensihoito saapuivat paikalle useiden ilmoitusten jälkeen. Pelastajat yrittivät elvyttää kahta uhria, mutta Seattlen pelastuslaitos totesi heidät kuolleiksi tapahtumapaikalla. Kolmas vakavasti haavoittunut uhri vietiin Harborview Medical Centeriin, jossa hän kuoli myöhemmin vammoihinsa.

Neljä muuta loukkaantunutta kuljetettiin sairaalaan, ja heidän tilansa ilmoitettiin myöhemmin vakaaksi. Viides loukkaantunut ei halunnut sairaalakuljetusta. Loukkaantuneiden joukossa oli kaksivuotias poika. Kuolonuhrien määrä tarkentui illan aikana, kun sairaalaan viety kolmas uhri menehtyi.

Tapahtumapaikka oli noin korttelin päässä Space Needlestä, yhdessä Seattlen suosituimmista matkailukohteista. [i24NEWSin](https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/americas/artc-seattle-two-dead-and-five-injured-in-a-shooting-at-a-food-festival) mukaan Bite of Seattle kokoaa vuosittain Seattle Centeriin kymmeniä ruokakojuja ja ulkoilmakonsertteja. Laukausten jälkeen väkijoukko hajaantui ja ihmiset hakivat suojaa. Verkossa julkaistuilla videoilla festivaalikävijöitä näkyi Space Needlen sisällä, ja yksi paikalla ollut kuvasi tilannetta paikallismedialle täydeksi kaaokseksi.

## Poliisi etsii paennutta epäiltyä

Poliisin tiedotus epäiltyjen kiinniotoista muuttui sunnuntai-illan kuluessa. Aluksi kerrottiin kahden epäillyn olevan poliisin hallussa, mutta myöhemmin ilmoitus korjattiin: kiinni oli vain yksi, ja toinen oli paennut. Poliisi käynnisti etsinnän paenneen epäillyn löytämiseksi. Viranomaisten mukaan tapahtuman jälkeen ei kuitenkaan ollut jatkuvaa uhkaa yleisölle.

Washingtonin kuvernööri Bob Ferguson tuomitsi ampumisen järjettömänä väkivaltana ja sanoi ajatustensa olevan uhrien perheiden sekä turvallisuutta ylläpitävien pelastajien luona. Seattlea kongressissa edustava Pramila Jayapal ilmaisi osanottonsa kaikille tapahtumasta kärsineille ja käytti väkivallasta samaa luonnehdintaa. Space Needlen huipulla oleva Yhdysvaltain lippu laskettiin ampumisen jälkeen puolitankoon.
summary_bullets: Kolme ihmistä kuoli ja useita loukkaantui Seattle Centerissä.
Poliisin mukaan kaksi epäiltyä ampui toisiaan kohti.
Yksi epäilty on kiinni ja toinen yhä kateissa.
payload.journalist_note: Kuolonuhrien määrä tarkentui kahdesta kolmeen yhden sairaalaan viedyn uhrin kuoltua. Loukkaantuneiden kokonaismäärä jätettiin yleisluontoiseksi, koska varhaisissa tiedoissa käytettiin erilaisia laskentatapoja.

Kolmas vakavasti haavoittunut uhri vietiin Harborview Medical Centeriin, jossa hän kuoli myöhemmin vammoihinsa.

Neljä muuta loukkaantunutta kuljetettiin sairaalaan, ja heidän tilansa ilmoitettiin myöhemmin vakaaksi. Viides loukkaantunut ei halunnut sairaalakuljetusta. Loukkaantuneiden joukossa oli kaksivuotias poika. Kuolonuhrien määrä tarkentui illan aikana, kun sairaalaan viety kolmas uhri menehtyi.

Tapahtumapaikka oli noin korttelin päässä Space Needlestä, yhdessä Seattlen suosituimmista matkailukohteista. [i24NEWSin](https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/americas/artc-seattle-two-dead-and-five-injured-in-a-shooting-at-a-food-festival) mukaan Bite of Seattle kokoaa vuosittain Seattle Centeriin kymmeniä ruokakojuja ja ulkoilmakonsertteja. Laukausten jälkeen väkijoukko hajaantui ja ihmiset hakivat suojaa. Verkossa julkaistuilla videoilla festivaalikävijöitä näkyi Space Needlen sisällä, ja yksi paikalla ollut kuvasi tilannetta paikallismedialle täydeksi kaaokseksi.

## Poliisi etsii paennutta epäiltyä

Poliisin tiedotus epäiltyjen kiinniotoista muuttui sunnuntai-illan kuluessa. Aluksi kerrottiin kahden epäillyn olevan poliisin hallussa, mutta myöhemmin ilmoitus korjattiin: kiinni oli vain yksi, ja toinen oli paennut. Poliisi käynnisti etsinnän paenneen epäillyn löytämiseksi. Viranomaisten mukaan tapahtuman jälkeen ei kuitenkaan ollut jatkuvaa uhkaa yleisölle.

Washingtonin kuvernööri Bob Ferguson tuomitsi ampumisen järjettömänä väkivaltana ja sanoi ajatustensa olevan uhrien perheiden sekä turvallisuutta ylläpitävien pelastajien luona. Seattlea kongressissa edustava Pramila Jayapal ilmaisi osanottonsa kaikille tapahtumasta kärsineille ja käytti väkivallasta samaa luonnehdintaa. Space Needlen huipulla oleva Yhdysvaltain lippu laskettiin ampumisen jälkeen puolitankoon.

Witnesses describe 'horrible' and 'chaotic' scene after Seattle Center shooting Three people have been killed and several others injured following a shooting at a food festival near the Space Needle in Seattle on Sunday. Police said there were two suspects who were shooting at each other. One of the suspects is in custody and the other still at large, although officials have said there is no threat to public. Shots rang out at around 18:00 local time (01:00 GMT) at one of the city's most popular tourist spots and as the annual Bite of Seattle food festival drew even more people to the downtown area. Two deaths were confirmed at the scene, and one person died later in hospital. Those injured include a two-year-old boy, officials said. Videos shared online showed people taking shelter inside the city's iconic Space Needle.

A shooting broke out Sunday evening at the Seattle Center, on the sidelines of the annual food festival Bite of Seattle near the Space Needle, leaving at least two dead and five injured, according to law enforcement. Emergency services responded shortly after 6 PM following several reports of gunshots. Medical teams attempted to resuscitate two victims, but they were declared dead at the scene by Seattle firefighters. The third victim was taken to Harborview Medical Center but died from their injuries. Four other people were injured and are receiving care. The shooting occurred while thousands of visitors were attending this popular event, which every year brings together dozens of food stalls and outdoor concerts at the Seattle Center. One person was arrested and taken into custody, but police have launched a manhunt for a second suspect who fled the scene.

A tragic shooting incident at the annual Bite of Seattle Festival has left two dead and multiple injured, including a young child, highlighting the ongoing issue of gun violence in the US. Two people were killed and several others were injured -- including a child -- in a shooting incident reported at the Seattle food festival on July 26, Sunday evening in the USA, CNN reported, citing fire department officials. CNN reported that the shooting took place just a block from the city's iconic Space Needle. The Seattle Fire Department said that it responded to reports of a shooting at the Seattle Center just after 6 pm (local time). As per a report by AP, as many as five patients were admitted to the Harborview Medical Centre. A 56-year-old woman was in serious condition while being transported to the hospital.

She had originally announced two suspects had been taken into custody before updating her statement later on Sunday evening. Four of the injured were taken to hospital in a stable condition, while a fifth chose not to, the fire department said. One attendee told local media that scene was "pure chaos" following the gunfire Representatives for Seattle and Washington state have condemned the shooting as an act of "senseless violence". "My prayers are with the families of the victims, and the responders as they work to keep people safe," Washington Governor Bob Ferguson said on social media. The US flag on top of the Space Needle was lowered to half-mast after the shooting Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal, who represents Seattle, added: "Our hearts go out to all those impacted by this senseless violence," she wrote on social media.
